justifications.unit: Unit tests drive the send, schedule and cancel paths with a substitute client and sender.
justifications.guard: Guard tests cover the argument checks only, a small share of the lines.
justifications.integration: Integration tests drive queue send, topic publish, schedule and the id, subject and content-type propagation against the official Azure Service Bus emulator and receive with a raw client; the uncovered lines are the cancel success path of the integration flag only, because the emulator accepts a cancel but still delivers the message so that integration test is skipped (the contract flag reaches it).
justifications.contract: Contract tests run the real publisher against the emulator and assert the IAzureServiceBusMessagePublisher Right/Left contract for send, publish, schedule and cancel, including the stable error codes on a rejected call.

EncinaAzureServiceBusOptions.cs.reason: Configuration POCO with defaults and validation

justifications.integration: Integration tests register the package through AddEncinaAzureServiceBus with the emulator connection string and queue names, so the option properties and defaults are read; the ToString override is covered by the unit flag.

Health/AzureServiceBusHealthCheck.cs.reason: Health check with mockeable service dependencies

justifications.integration: Integration tests run the health check against the emulator client for the healthy result and against a closed client for the unhealthy result; the ServiceBusException catch needs a client that throws on access.
justifications.contract: Contract tests run the real health check with the emulator client and assert the IEncinaHealthCheck name, tags and healthy status; the closed-client and exception branches are covered by the integration flag.

IAzureServiceBusMessagePublisher.cs.reason: Interfaces have no implementation to test

justifications.unit: The whole registration is a short linear method fully exercised by the DI tests.
justifications.guard: Guard tests call the registration with null arguments and with valid arguments, reaching every line.
justifications.integration: Integration tests build the provider with ValidateOnBuild and ValidateScopes both with a pre-registered emulator client and with the package's own client built from the connection string, so every registration line runs; the argument-guard throws are covered by the guard flag.
